subject: Orchestration: availability matrix & IT inclusion for inbound trial walkthrough
messages:
From: onboarding@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett, marta.novak@novasys.eu
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: Thanks for requesting a Redwood trial walkthrough — next steps

Hi Marta and team,

Thanks for signing up for a Redwood trial. We received your request (Case ID 9243) and would love to schedule a short walkthrough (30–45 min) with an AE + SE. To make scheduling easier, here are three proposed windows in UTC:

- Tue Aug 6 — 08:00–09:00 UTC
- Wed Aug 7 — 07:30–08:15 UTC
- Thu Aug 8 — 13:00–13:45 UTC

If you need us to include IT/security or adapt to maintenance windows, reply here and we’ll loop in the right people.

Quick note: we typically include a brief SOC2 summary and an agenda PDF in the invite.

Regards,
Redwood Onboarding Team

(Attachment: onboarding-checklist.txt)
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Novak <marta.novak@novasys.eu>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 08:32:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Thanks for requesting a Redwood trial walkthrough — next steps

Hi Marta — thanks for signing up and welcome!

Quick intro: I’m Priyom (SDR) — looping in Laura (AM), Karthik (AE) and Soojin (SE) so we can lock a time that works for Novasys and include your IT/security stakeholders.

To help us pick a time that avoids maintenance windows, could you confirm which of these slots works in CEST (your timezone):

- Tue Aug 6 — 10:00–11:00 CEST (08:00–09:00 UTC) — morning slot
- Wed Aug 7 — 09:30–10:15 CEST (07:30–08:15 UTC) — earlier morning
- Thu Aug 8 — 15:00–15:45 CEST (13:00–13:45 UTC) — afternoon slot

We’d like to include Soojin (SE) on the call for any infra/IT questions and to make sure we cover the private deployment options. If you have a preferred security contact, please add them — otherwise we’ll invite an IT specialist from your team.

Thanks,
Priyom
SDR, Redwood Inference

(Attachment: lead-intake-summary.txt)
From: Marta Novak <marta.novak@novasys.eu>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, carlos.diaz@americorp.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 13:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Thanks for requesting a Redwood trial walkthrough — next steps

Hi Priyom & team,

Thanks — good to meet you (virtually). A few constraints from our side:

- Our IT maintenance window is daily 14:00–16:00 CEST; we prefer any external calls in the morning (08:30–11:30 CEST).
- Please include the SE: we need infra-level answers about VPC peering and KMS.
- Security wants to review a short SOC2 + data flow summary ahead of time; I’ve attached our internal intake checklist we use when vendors request demos.

I’m copying Carlos (partner security lead) who will help verify compliance scope. Carlos — can you join the call if we pick Wed Aug 7 09:30 CEST? If that’s tight, Tue Aug 6 10:00 CEST also works.

Best,
Marta
IT Manager, Novasys

(Attachment: novasys-it-requirements.xlsx)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Novak <marta.novak@novasys.eu>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 15:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Orchestration: availability matrix & IT inclusion for inbound trial walkthrough

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear constraints and for attaching the intake checklist.

Summary / proposal:
- We’ll target Wed Aug 7 at 09:30 CEST (07:30 UTC). That keeps the meeting squarely in your morning window and avoids your maintenance period.
- Attendees from Redwood: Laura (AM), Karthik (AE), Soojin (SE). We’ll block 45 minutes and send a calendar invite with an agenda and a short SOC2 summary.
- We’ll include time for IT questions early in the call (first 15 minutes) so Carlos and your IT team can validate VPC and KMS details.

Action items for Marta/Novasys:
- Confirm Wed Aug 7 09:30 CEST is OK for Carlos/IT.
- Let us know if the meeting should be limited to 30 minutes instead of 45.

I’ll attach a short agenda and SOC2 one-pager in the invite.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood-demo-brief-agenda.pdf; soc2-summary.pdf)
From: Marta Novak <marta.novak@novasys.eu>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Diaz <carlos.diaz@americorp.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Aug 2028 09:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Orchestration: availability matrix & IT inclusion for inbound trial walkthrough

Laura — confirmed. Wed Aug 7 09:30 CEST (07:30 UTC) works for me and Carlos. We’ll plan 45 min and Carlos will drop off after the IT/KMS segment if needed.

Please send the calendar invite with the agenda and the SOC2 one-pager so our security team can file it.

See you then,
Marta
